certifications.heading: Certification records
certifications.empty: No level certifications yet — add their first certification above.
certifications.sightCardHint: The diver told us this level. Enter the agency and number from the certification record you verified.
certifications.sightNitroxCardHint: The diver told us they're nitrox certified. Enter what the digital certification record or other certification evidence shows. RAID and GUE don't issue a separate nitrox credential — their enriched air is covered by the level credential (RAID Open Water 20 or Advanced 35, GUE Fundamentals or Rec 1), so record that credential. Every other agency issues a separate enriched-air credential, and a level credential from them is not nitrox evidence.
certifications.sightCardLevelHint: Prefilled with what the diver said. Change it to match the certification record you verified.
certifications.cardNumberShapeHint: At least three characters, including a digit — the number recorded in the certification record.
certifications.clearNoCertificationHint: Someone said on a public form that this diver has no certification. Anyone who knows their name and email can leave that answer, so clear it if they didn't give it. Clearing records who corrected it and leaves the record saying nothing about certification — never that they're certified — and the deal and wait lists stop flagging them as uncertified.
certifications.noCertificationClearedNote: A “not certified yet” answer was cleared from this record by {name} on {date}.
certifications.noCertificationRestated: Staff cleared this answer once before and it has been given again on a public form since. Anyone who knows this diver's name and email can leave it.

removed.heading: This diver is deleted
removed.body: Out of the roster, booking pickers, manifests, and trip prep. Their records stay on file.
removed.restoreRestricted: Only owners and managers can restore a diver.

erase.heading: Erase personal data
erase.description: Destroys this diver's details for good. Not the same as deleting them.
erase.destroyedNote: Destroyed: name, email, phone, date of birth, emergency contact, insurance, certification numbers and evidence photos, medical answers, rental sizes, staff notes, review comments, and any photos they shared.
erase.keptNote: Kept, with their name gone from all of it: that they signed your release, which version, and when — plus the trips they were on and what was paid. Signed releases stay verifiable.

rentalFit.heading: Rental fit
rentalFit.description: What the trip prep list is built from — never a reservation, and never a substitute for a dock-side fit check.
rentalFit.changeRestricted: Changing what this diver asked for is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters.
rentalFit.cantFillHeading: Can't fill one of these sizes?
rentalFit.flaggedBody: They still count on the prep list, but without a size — the crew fits them from what's aboard.
rentalFit.cantFillBody: Their count stays on the packing list but the size comes off, so nobody lays out a size the shop is short of.
rentalFit.fitResolved: Fit resolved — pack their sizes again
rentalFit.clearingRestricted: Clearing this is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters — they confirm the diver can be packed to their stated sizes again.

notices.verified: Certification marked verified. It counts toward readiness.
notices.cardRestored: Certification restored. It counts toward readiness again.
notices.cardRestoreConflict: Couldn't restore that certification — another record now uses its number. Re-add it if you still need it.
notices.notAuthorizedDetails: Your account can’t edit this diver for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.fitCleared: Fit flag cleared — this diver packs from their stated sizes again.
notices.duplicate: Another diver already uses that email in this shop.

notices.booked: Activity booked. Review it below, then create and send the invoice.
notices.bookedWaiverUndelivered: Activity booked — but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Open the trip’s guest list to send it or share the link.
notices.tripFull: That activity just filled up. Choose another.
notices.alreadyBooked: This diver is already booked on that activity.
notices.courseUnstaffed: Assign an instructor before booking this course.
notices.coursePrerequisite: Mark the required certification as certified before booking this course.
notices.courseRatioFull: This session is at its instructor-to-student ratio limit. Assign another instructor, or choose another activity.
notices.courseMinAge: This diver is under that course's minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on file. Correct the date of birth if it's wrong.
notices.tripPrerequisite: This diver's certifications on file don't reach what that trip and its dive sites require. Open the trip to see what it asks for.
notices.tripUnavailable: Add an email and choose an available activity.
notices.bookingInvalid: Add an email and choose an available activity.
notices.refundFailed: That payment could not be refunded. It may not be paid, or Stripe may need attention.
notices.refundInProgress: A refund for this order is already going through. Give it a moment, then refresh — don't send it again.
notices.demoDisabled: This is a demo order — it can't be refunded.
notices.restoreRefused: Couldn't restore this diver — an active diver now uses their email. Change that email, then try again.
notices.removedReadOnly: Restore this diver before changing their details.
notices.paymentNotConnected: Payments aren't connected yet — connect them to charge this diver.
notices.notAuthorizedRefund: Refunds are limited to owners and managers — ask one of them to issue this refund.
notices.notAuthorizedDelete: Deleting a diver is limited to owners and managers — ask one of them to do it.
notices.notAuthorizedErase: Erasing a diver's personal data is limited to the shop owner — ask them to do it.
notices.eraseNameMismatch: The name you typed doesn't match this diver's, so nothing was erased. Type it exactly as it appears above.
notices.eraseRefused: This record can't be erased. Staff records keep the shop's own accountability trail, and you can't erase your own.
notices.eraseRequiresDelete: Not erased. Delete this diver first.
notices.notAuthorizedFit: Changing a diver's stated rental fit is limited to owners, managers, instructors, and divemasters. You can still flag them for hands-on fitting at check-in.
notices.notAuthorizedWaiver: Your account can’t record a paper waiver for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.invalid: Check the details and try again.
notices.waiverPaperRecorded: Paper waiver recorded — signed and on file.
notices.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver — or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notices.waiverError: That paper waiver couldn’t be recorded. Open the diver’s next departure to see why.
notices.cardSightingRequired: This certification is only what the diver told us. Enter the agency and number from the certification record to verify it.
notices.cardNumberImplausible: That doesn't look like a certification number. Type the number exactly as shown in the certification record, digits included.
notices.noCertificationCleared: Cleared. This diver's record no longer says anything about certification — clearing never adds one.
notices.duplicateCard: Another live certification at this shop already has that number. Check the number, or delete the certification that holds it.
notices.noCertificationNothingToClear: Nothing to clear — this diver's record no longer says they have no certification.
notices.notAuthorizedCards: Your account can't change certifications for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
notices.notAuthorizedNotes: Your account can’t change this diver’s notes for this shop any more. Ask an owner or manager to check your access.
